title: Rust: ETL Data Pipeline
description: Build an ETL data pipeline with extract, transform, and load stages.

steps.title: Extractor Stage
steps.description: Implement an `Extractor` that reads from a `Vec<String>` data source. Use `Iterator` trait. Create sample data: `["name,age", "Alice,30", "Bob,25"]`. Print each line as it's extracted.
hints: `impl Iterator for CsvExtractor { type Item = String; fn next(&mut self) -> Option<String> { ... } }`

verification.failureMessage: Extract and print lines from the data source.

steps.title: Transformer Stage
steps.description: Create a `Transformer` that wraps an iterator and applies transformations. Implement `map_fn<F>(self, f: F)` that transforms each item. Test by uppercasing all text.
hints: `struct Transformer<I, F> { iter: I, f: F }`
`impl<I, F, T, U> Iterator for Transformer<I, F> where I: Iterator<Item=T>, F: Fn(T) -> U { type Item = U; fn next(&mut self) -> Option<U> { self.iter.next().map(&self.f) } }`

verification.failureMessage: Uppercase all extracted data and print.

steps.title: Filter Stage
steps.description: Add a `Filter` stage that only keeps items matching a predicate. Chain: Extractor → Filter (age > 25) → Print. Parse CSV, filter rows, print result.

verification.successMessage: Filter stage works! Alice (30) passes, Bob (25) filtered out.
verification.failureMessage: Filter rows where age > 25 and print.

steps.title: Pipeline with Error Handling
steps.description: Add error handling: parse lines as `Result<Record, String>`. Use `filter_map` to skip errors while continuing. Demonstrate with a CSV line that has invalid data.
hints: Collect into `Result<Vec<_>, _>` and print errors also.

verification.failureMessage: Process data with some invalid lines, print valid data and errors.

steps.title: Metrics and Reporting
steps.description: Add pipeline metrics: track rows processed, errors, transformation count. After pipeline execution, print a report with all metrics.
hints: Use a `Metrics` struct with atomic counters.
Wrap the pipeline in a `MonitoredPipeline` that updates metrics.

verification.failureMessage: Run the pipeline and print a metrics report.
